art_direction: User-approved rain-soaked rune battlefield, burning villages, cyan forest magic.

sources.origin: New generated environment painting in this conversation, subsequently processed into repeat-compatible strips.
Earlier user-approved concept from this conversation; structure cutouts and endcap scenery extracted from it.

derivatives.ground_and_backdrops: Three phase-shifted variants from the same painting. Shared edge collars and periodic boundary blending; not three wholly independent paintings.
derivatives.endcaps: Left edge crop from approved concept; right endcap is a horizontal mirror. Creatures within endcaps are static scenic silhouettes, not animated gameplay units.
derivatives.structures: Cropped with protected-foreground masks and color matting. Original cyan/fire glow retained conservatively. Not SVG, not hand-separated rigs.
derivatives.fx: Deterministic technical rain, ember, smoke and radial glow textures; seeded procedural raster generation.

checks: See metadata/validation_report.json. No Godot game or GPU rendering was run for this pack.
